item.title: Fitness: knowing you are doing enough to stay fit
item.description:
I am 55 years old and I do work out occassionally. I have noticed that I like to know what I should do to stay fit. Now there is plenty advice on the most elaborate training programs, but it seems that if you start looking into that, the advice is to keep increasing the amount, the weight and the frequency.

Being 55, I am mainly interested in staying fit andstrond, not sop much getting a lot stronger. The downside of the elaborate program or extensive training regime, is that it can feel as so much that you feel you can not live up to the expectations and therefor you quit early.
